headline: Discussion of the November 7, 2026 Community Planning Workshop, a fall citywide engagement event.
summary: The committee will discuss the Community Planning Workshop set for November 7, 2026, including event details, materials, and promotion. It will also prepare feedback to send to the project consultant.
items: Discuss the November 7, 2026 Community Planning Workshop, including event plans, materials, and promotion
Prepare feedback to give to the project consultant
location: Conference Room 105, Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA

COMPREHENSIVE MASTER PLAN STEERING COMMITTEE 
  
MEETING 
  
The Comprehensive Master Plan Steering Committee will hold a meeting in Malden City 
Hall, Conference Room 105, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA, at 6:30 PM on                      
Wednesday, October 14, 2026. 
     AGENDA   
 
1. Call to Order. 
2. Roll Call. 
3. Fall Citywide community engagement event, Community Planning Workshop,  
November 7, 2026 - discuss event, materials and promotion, prepare feedback to give to 
project consultant. 
4. Any other business properly before the Committee. 
5. Adjournment. 
 
                                                      By:  Charles Ioven, Chair 
                                                              Planning Board   
  Comprehensive Master Plan Steering Committee 
 
 
 If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation, please contact Maria Luise, ADA Compliance
